acceptance_criteria.source: "Is there anything holding us back from switching back to main" — the user's stated goal is to get back onto main once it is safe.

acceptance_criteria.source: "...and killing this branch?" — the user's stated goal is to remove the current branch once it is safe.
acceptance_criteria.text: If nothing would be lost, the local licensing-and-decisions branch is deleted; otherwise the user is told what blocks deleting it.

acceptance_criteria.source: "The README.md file has a section about iCloud Drive. Remove it."

The README change is committed to the repository.
The commit containing the README change is pushed to the origin remote, or the user is told the push could not be performed and why.
